I, 5 "A wise man shall hear and shall be wiser". and he that under- standeth, shall possess governments.
1, 7 " The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom".
VI, 16 "Six things there are, which the Lord hateth, and the 7th His soul detesteth" - Haughty eyes , a lying tongue, hand that shed inno- cent blood, a heart that deviset wicked plots, feet that are swift to run into mischief, a deceitful witness that uttereth lies and him that soweth discord among brethren".
XII, 1 "He that loveth correction, loveth knowledge; but he that hateth reproof is fo lish."
XV, 1 "A mild answer breaketh rath; but a harsh word sturreth up fury".
XVI, 24 Prov. "Well ordered words are as honey comb: sweet to the soul, and health to the bones."
XVII, 3 "As silver is tried by fire, and gold in the furnace: so the Lord trieth the hearts."
= 15 "He that justifieth the wicked and he that condemneth the just, both are abominable before God."
XVIII, 12 "Before destruction the heart of a man is exalted: but before he be glorified, it is humbled."
Page 168 XX1, 23 "He that keepeth his mouth and his tongue, keepeth his soul from distress."
XX1, 30 "There is no wisom, there is no prudence, there is no counsel against the Lord."
XXV, 11 Prov. "To speak a word in due time is like apples of gold on beds of silver."
XXVIII, 23 "He that rebuketh a man, shall afterward find favor with him, more than he who by a flattering tongue deceiveth him."
